facts.fact: Address can be updated online on myAadhaar (myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in)
facts.quote: Using Online services for address update and document update available at https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/

facts.fact: The myAadhaar service is called 'Update Address' (under Update Services), with the routes 'Using your document' and 'Using your family member's Aadhaar' and a 'Start' button
facts.note: Screen labels are only on the myAadhaar app pages, which return HTTP 500 to the checker's browser and only a title to a plain fetch (28 Oct 2026); a person must check them.

facts.fact: An address update costs Rs 75 (a demographic update done separately)
facts.quote: (2) Demographic update: Update of enrolled name, gender, date of birth, address, mobile number or email address, or any combination of the same (i) If done at the same time with biometric update: Free (ii) If done separately: ₹75
facts.note: UIDAI's fee schedule; an old FAQ answer on uidai.gov.in/en/enrolment-and-update still says 'for online update of address you have to pay Rs. 50/- (including GST)' (stale). The myAadhaar page that shows 75 is blocked for the checker.

facts.fact: The charges are inclusive of GST (any applicable taxes)
facts.quote: These charges are inclusive of any applicable taxes.

facts.fact: myAadhaar shows the address update as 'Up to 30 days'
facts.note: Shown only on the myAadhaar service card, which blocks the checker (HTTP 500 in the browser). The UIDAI FAQ says 'Normally 90% of the update request is completed within 30 days.' Note: UIDAI's Citizen's Charter (January 2024, backend.uidai.gov.in/get/files/media/document/2026-05/Citizen_Charter_Jan24.pdf) gives 'Normally up to 60 days' for a HoF-based address update, including the 30-day HoF acceptance period, so the Fail-if on any time other than 'up to 30 days' may be too strict for the HoF route.

facts.fact: For the family member (Head of Family) based address update, UIDAI's Citizen's Charter gives a service standard of normally up to 60 days, which includes the 30 days the HoF has to accept the request
facts.was: 'Up to 30 days' for every address update route (old Fail if: any processing time other than 'up to 30 days')
facts.quote: C. HOF Based Address Update Normally up Aadhaar number holder can update address in to 60 days
facts.note: UIDAI Citizen's Charter (January 2024), 6.4 Demographic and Biometric Update Service, row C. The table's columns run together in the PDF text, so the quote reads 'Normally up ... to 60 days'; the same cell goes on 'from the date of update, by Aadhaar number holder, including 30 days of HOF acceptance period'. Row A (demographic update) gives 'Normally up to 30 days'.

facts.fact: Only an Aadhaar number holder whose mobile number is registered with Aadhaar can use the online service
facts.quote: Is it necessary that my mobile number should be registered with Aadhaar while requesting for any kind of update through online? Yes, mobile number should be registered to Aadhaar for using online services.

facts.fact: Login to myAadhaar is with the Aadhaar number and an OTP sent to the registered mobile
facts.quote: Please visit myAadhaar Portal , and log in using your Aadhaar number and one-time password (OTP) received on your registered mobile number.

facts.fact: Route (a), own document: upload a scan of a valid proof of address in pdf or jpeg format in the Update Address service
facts.quote: You will be prompted to upload scan/image of the supporting document in pdf or jpeg format in the Update Address online Service.

facts.fact: A rent agreement need not be registered: List IV item 24 accepts a registered or unregistered rent, lease or leave and licence agreement
facts.quote: Valid sale agreement/ gift deed registered with the Registrar Office, or registered or 24. unregistered rent, lease agreement or leave and licence agreement

facts.fact: The document must be in the applicant's own name and the address entered must match the document; the upload must be a clear colour scan of the original
facts.quote: Document is in the name of the Aadhaar holder for whom update request is submitted. Address details entered should match the address with the address mentioned in the document. Image uploaded should be clear and colored scan of original document.

facts.fact: For a rent agreement or passport, images of all (multiple) pages are needed
facts.quote: For certain documents like Passport, Rent and Property agreement, image of multiple pages would be required.

facts.fact: Other proofs of address include electricity, water and telephone/broadband bills not older than 3 months
facts.quote: 20. Electricity bill (pre-paid/post-paid bill, not older than 3 months) 21. Water bill (not older than 3 months) 22. Telephone landline bill/ post-paid mobile bill/ broadband bill (not older than 3 months)

facts.fact: A gas bill not older than 3 months is also accepted
facts.quote: 25. Gas bill (not older than 3 months)

facts.fact: A certificate in the UIDAI Standard Certificate format from an MP/MLA/MLC/Municipal Councillor, a Gazetted Officer Group A/EPFO officer, or a Tehsildar/Gazetted Officer Group B is accepted as proof of address
facts.quote: 19. Certificate issued on UIDAI Standard Certificate format by: i. MP / MLA / MLC / Municipal Councillor ii. Gazetted Officer Group ‘A’/ Employees Provident Fund Organisation (EPFO) Officer iii. Tehsildar/ Gazetted Officer Group ‘B’

facts.fact: In rural areas the certificate can also be issued by the Village Panchayat Head or equivalent authority
facts.quote: vii. Village Panchayat Head/ President or Mukhiya/ Gaon Bura/ equivalent authority (for rural areas)/ Village Panchayat Secretary/ Village Revenue Officer or equivalent (for rural areas)

facts.fact: The UIDAI-format certificate is valid for 3 months from issue
facts.quote: CERTIFICATE FOR AADHAAR ENROLMENT/ UPDATE (TO BE USED ONLY AS PROOF OF ADDRESS*) Instructions: All details to be filled in Block Letters (To be valid for 3 months from date of issue)

facts.fact: Route (b), family member's Aadhaar (Head of Family): for a person with no proof of address in their own name who lives at the same address as a family member, using that family member's (HoF's) consent
facts.quote: Family member-based address update process is a facility which can be availed by Aadhaar Number Holder (ANH) who does not possess a supporting proof of address (PoA) document in their own name. An ANH residing at the same address as a family member can update their Aadhaar address using that Head of Family consent.

facts.fact: The HoF route is available on myAadhaar and the Aadhaar App under the 'Family Member's Aadhaar' based address update option
facts.quote: This can be done by providing necessary details on the ‘ My Aadhaar ’ portal or the ‘Aadhaar App’ under the “Family Member’s Aadhaar” Based Address Update" option.

facts.fact: The HoF-route update goes through only with the family member's (HoF's) consent/approval
facts.quote: If residing at the same address, ANH can update their Aadhaar details based on the consent of a Head of Famil.

facts.fact: Relationship can be shown by a proof-of-relationship document or a self-declaration from the family member certifying the relationship (List IV item 30, only for borrowing a family member's address)
facts.quote: Self-declaration from an immediate family member certifying the relationship with 30. the individual residing at the same address. (Valid only for borrowing the address of an immediate family member for address update)

facts.fact: The HoF self-declaration (UIDAI format) is valid only for HoF-based address update and for 3 months from issue
facts.quote: 1. This document is valid for Head of Family (HoF) based Aadhaar address update purpose only. 2. This document is valid for 3 months from date of issue

facts.fact: The address can also be updated at any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre with a valid proof of address
facts.quote: You can update your address online through myAadhaar portal or by visiting any Aadhaar Enrolment Centre by enrolling with valid POA document.

facts.fact: Document update (re-submitting proofs for unchanged details) is a different service: free on myAadhaar till 14.06.2027
facts.quote: (ii) Using myAadhaar portal ( https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/du ): Free (till 14.06.2027)

facts.fact: Document update costs Rs 75 at an Aadhaar centre
facts.quote: (i) At Aadhaar centre: ₹75 (ii) Using myAadhaar portal ( https://myaadhaar.uidai.gov.in/du ): Free (till 14.06.2027)
facts.note: An old FAQ answer on uidai.gov.in/en/aadhaar-online-services still says 'For submission of documents at an Aadhaar centre, the applicable charge is Rs. 50' (stale vs the fee schedule).

facts.fact: The Aadhaar App also offers Address Update
facts.quote: Presently, the Aadhaar app offers various services like - Mobile Number Update, Address Update, Biometric lock/unlock, Selective Sharing of Aadhaar Verifiable Credential, check Authentication History, download e-Aadhaar, share Contact Card, Track my request, etc.

facts.fact: Step: the new address is entered in English and auto-transliterated into the regional language
facts.quote: You have to enter the details in English, which shall be transliterated into your selected regional language.

facts.fact: Step (HoF route): enter the family member's Aadhaar number and relationship details
facts.note: The HoF form fields are only on myAadhaar (blocked for the checker); the UIDAI FAQ says only 'providing necessary details'.

facts.fact: Step: pay the fee online on the portal; the request is then served with an SRN on the acknowledgement receipt
facts.quote: Online update request is deemed "served" after downloadable acknowledgement receipt (invoice) is generated with Service Request Number (SRN) after successful processing of payment on the portal.

facts.fact: Step: the SRN is shown on screen and sent by SMS; download the invoice/receipt with the SRN
facts.quote: On successful submission of an online address update request, a SRN (Service Request Number) is generated, which is shown on screen and also sent via SMS to your registered mobile number. After successful submission of the request, please download the invoice containing the SRN number and other details.

facts.fact: Step: track the update request with 'Check Aadhaar Update Status' on myAadhaar
facts.quote: The status of the update request can be checked at the bottom of the page by login in to Check Aadhaar Update Status
facts.note: UIDAI's enrolment-and-update FAQ links the same check as 'Check Enrolment & Update Status'.

summary: Rs 75 fee, registered mobile/OTP, document rules (unregistered rent agreement OK, own name, matching address, colour scan, multi-page), other PoA and certificate issuers/3-month validity, HoF route with consent and self-declaration, centre option and free document update till 14.06.2027 confirmed on uidai.gov.in and the List of Supporting Documents; myAadhaar screen labels and 'Up to 30 days' are manual (myAadhaar blocks the checker); FAQ still shows a stale Rs 50.
behaviour: Options only from UIDAI pages (myAadhaar / uidai.gov.in / List of Acceptable Documents / Citizen's Charter) with citation; no invented route; does not ask for the user's Aadhaar number or OTP. Gives the steps: myAadhaar 'Update Address' (or the Aadhaar App), choose 'Using your document' (rent agreement or other PoA in own name) or 'Using your family member's Aadhaar' (no PoA), OTP login, enter the address / upload the PoA or give the family member's details, pay Rs 75, note the SRN and track the request; for the HoF route the family member must approve.
fail_if: Says address change is free (confuses with Document update free till 14/06/2027) or quotes Rs 50 (stale fee still on an old uidai.gov.in FAQ); says the rent agreement must be registered/notarised; omits the family member (HoF) option for a person without proof; suggests agents/cyber cafes or unofficial portals (ssup.uidai.gov.in old links); invents a processing time: anything other than 'up to 30 days' for an update with the user's own document, or other than 'normally up to 60 days' (UIDAI Citizen's Charter, including the HoF's 30-day acceptance) for the family member (HoF) route.
